# agentbox

> Personal Claude Code Plugin Marketplace & Oh My Pi (omp) Developer Toolkit by duythien0912.

Modular visual artifact generators, durable multi-agent orchestration loops, and eval-gated optimization engines.

## Installation

### Claude Code
```text
/plugin marketplace add duythien0912/agentbox
/plugin install agentbox@agentbox
```

### Oh My Pi (omp)
```bash
bash scripts/setup-omp.sh
```

## Skills Catalog (19 Skills)

- `agentbox:guide`: Interactive concierge router mapping goals to skills and agents.
- `agentbox:pr-writeup`: Generates self-contained HTML pull request writeups with file tours and test plans.
- `agentbox:plan-deck`: Transforms specifications into structured HTML implementation decks.
- `agentbox:codewalk`: Creates interactive HTML code walkthroughs with file:line anchors.
- `agentbox:flowchart`: Generates interactive Mermaid flowcharts with per-node inspector panels.
- `agentbox:component-diagram`: Generates interactive component architecture diagrams with typed dependencies.
- `agentbox:sequence-diagram`: Generates interactive sequence diagrams with step-driven detail panels.
- `agentbox:c4-model`: Generates LikeC4 multi-view architectural diagrams via containerized renderer.
- `agentbox:deep-understanding`: Interactive tutor assessing and quizzing understanding of diffs and subsystems.
- `agentbox:conductor`: Durable workflow runner with crash-resilience, worktree isolation, and enforcement gates.
- `agentbox:prospector`: Sequential keep-or-discard hill-climbing loop optimizing objective code scalars.
- `agentbox:whetstone`: Overnight eval-gated skill improver resolving backlogs through frozen checks.
- `agentbox:arena`: Reproducible pairwise leaderboard evaluating conductor outputs across test fixtures.
- `agentbox:loom`: Graph-shaped delivery loop with fork/rejoin regions, verified invariants, and browser preview.
- `agentbox:lanes`: External-agent execution model with append-only ledger and state reconciliation.
- `agentbox:lane-config`: Per-repo orchestration configuration for model effort, lane caps, and timeouts.
- `agentbox:skill-lint`: Deterministic analyzer auditing word budgets, structural tags, and triggers.
- `agentbox:plan-check`: Pre-flight plan audit against codebase evidence emitting GO/NO-GO reports.
- `agentbox:feedback`: User feedback intake converting experience into scrubbed GitHub issues.

## Agents Catalog (10 Agents)

### Directly Usable Subagents (Public)
- `agentbox-planner`: Decomposes goals into grounded code slices and checkable acceptance criteria with baselines.
- `agentbox-builder`: Implements scoped slices inside isolated worktrees against written acceptance criteria.
- `agentbox-verifier`: Independently verifies results at named commit SHAs with paired failure and pass proofs.
- `agentbox-code-reviewer`: Reviews changed code on a branch and resolves Critical/High findings in one pass.

### Automated Gate Workers (Conductor / Lanes)
- `agentbox-test-writer`: Authors failing acceptance tests prior to implementation.
- `agentbox-tryve-enhancer`: Hardens test coverage against implementation diffs (error paths, boundaries, auth).
- `agentbox-docs-writer`: Documents completed changes into docs/changes/ with structured frontmatter.
- `agentbox-web-verifier`: Verifies UI-touching web changes end-to-end with Playwright specs and screenshots.
- `agentbox-mobile-verifier`: Verifies mobile apps across React Native, Flutter, iOS, and Android simulators.
- `agentbox-herdr-orchestrator`: Orchestrates multi-agent sessions across external panes with strict adjudication.
